current_evidence: This is the live official council page ('What to submit with your application', with a 'Minimum local supporting information' section) in the Apply for planning permission section. It shows no adoption date, only the 2026 copyright footer. The longer 'Cheshire West and Chester Local List 1 March 2023' turned up only as a third-party copy on frodsham.gov.uk, and the council site does not link it, so it appears to have been replaced by this slimmed-down page.

issues.detail: Grokbot's status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong. The official page loads and is readable, but Grokbot captured 0 requirements, so every application-type row says 'Not covered'.
issues.evidence: Page loads with headings 'Minimum national requirements', 'Minimum local supporting information', 'Sustainable construction information requirements', 'Health impact information requirements' etc.

issues.detail: Sustainable construction information is missing. New-build dwellings (C3) need a Sustainable Housing Statement and a Sustainable Construction Checklist. Other development needs a Sustainable Construction Checklist if it creates more than 40 sqm of new-build floorspace, plus a BREEAM assessment if it is major development. Householder development needs neither.
issues.evidence: Table: New-build dwellings 'Sustainable Housing Statement and Sustainable Construction Checklist'; All other development 'Sustainable Construction Checklist if creating more than 40sqm new-build floorspace'; 'BREEAM assessment for major development*'

issues.detail: Health impact information is missing. It is required for major development (new-build dwellings and all other development) and for change of use providing 10 or more dwellings. It is not required for householder development.
issues.evidence: Health impact: Change of use 'Required where 10 or more dwellings are to be provided'; New-build dwellings / All other development 'Required for major development*'; Householder 'Not required'

issues.detail: Biodiversity net gain information is missing. Change of use, new-build dwellings and all other development (not householder) must follow DEFRA BNG guidance and Local Plan (Part Two) Policy DM44.
issues.evidence: Biodiversity net gain column: 'Refer to DEFRA guidance and Local Plan (Part Two) Policy DM44'

issues.detail: Hot food takeaway requirements are missing. These come from the linked guidance note dated July 2025 and apply to hot food takeaways, mixed-use schemes that include one, and new uses or variations of conditions. Applicants must submit a location map of nearby takeaways, a statement on whether the ward has high childhood obesity and high multiple deprivation, a BS4142 odour and noise assessment, and a site plan of waste storage.
issues.evidence: planningpolicy.cheshirewestandchester.gov.uk/guidance-and-advice-notes/hot-food-takeaway-requirements (Local Plan Part Two DM 29); 400m secondary school exclusion zone in high childhood-obesity wards

issues.detail: Two linked items are missing: the Rural worker dwellings advice note (rural worker dwellings) and the Minerals safeguarding guidance note (sites in mineral safeguarding areas). Their detailed triggers are in the linked notes, not on the page itself.
issues.evidence: Headings 'Rural worker dwellings advice note' and 'Minerals safeguarding guidance note' under the local supporting information section

issues.detail: Most application-type rows should say there are no local requirements, not 'Not covered'. The page says local supporting information is not automatically required for householder development, prior approval, listed building consent or lawful development certificates. Grokbot also missed the definition of 'major development' that sets these triggers.
issues.evidence: Major = 10+ dwellings; outline with unknown units on 0.5 ha+; 1,000 sqm+ new floorspace; or site 1 ha+ where floorspace unknown

summary: Grokbot's link is the current official page and it loads fine, but Grokbot wrongly marked it unreadable and captured nothing. All the local requirements are missing: sustainable construction and BREEAM, health impact, BNG, hot food takeaway, rural worker dwellings and minerals safeguarding. The page itself shows no adoption date.
